method: Read published evidence only; no new training, simulation, tests or benchmark.

critic_extreme_actual_update.actual_update_parameter_phase: Mean over the actual 5x4 evolving Critic optimizer minibatches; stored oldV/targets precede fitting.
critic_extreme_actual_update.selection: Highest normal-update critic_mse in block; top max_t abs(lambda_target-old_V).
critic_extreme_actual_update.parameter_phase: WM after normal fit; Actor before policy step; stored Critic before fitting.
critic_extreme_actual_update.termination_semantics: current_survival_weight is pre-transition; natural_end is boolean; geometric_termination_probability is analytic soft probability before natural-end override, without threshold.
critic_extreme_actual_update.state_layout: world root XYZ, root quaternion wxyz, 29 joints, 35 velocities, previous action; dt=.02
critic_extreme_actual_update.interpretation: Existing imagined samples, not Actor-gradient attribution or an exact checkpoint snapshot; yaw D is descriptive.

review_type: Existing published evidence and arithmetic only; no new training, inference, simulator, test, benchmark or archive in this review.

metric_definitions.normalized_return_R: For each clip, sum of step rewards divided by 0.1*(N_reference_frames-1); unexecuted failed suffix contributes zero. Dataset R is the arithmetic mean over all selected clips.
metric_definitions.completion_fraction_C: Arithmetic mean of executed_steps/full_reference_steps across clips; this differs from the fraction of clips completed.
metric_definitions.complete_motion: No physical termination before the natural full-reference end under the original height/tilt/nonfinite criteria; evaluation starts at frame0 without the training timeout.
metric_definitions.error_means: Within each clip, errors are averaged over executed steps; dataset error means weight clips equally. Common-complete sets are conditional comparisons, not all-motion scores.
metric_definitions.gap_decomposition: 1-R=(1-C)+(C-R). R+1-C is the conditional result if only missing suffixes were filled with maximum reward and the already executed segment were unchanged; it is not a future policy upper bound.
metric_definitions.hard_definition: Frozen639-member union: metadata Stunts OR motion name containing flip/side_roll/cartwheel/handstand; original source_clip_id identity, not selected by failures; general BONES still includes these members.
metric_definitions.exposure: Cumulative new-stage counts, including necessary replay fill where reported; reset-bin visitation does not imply effective WM k8 or Actor coverage at the same phase.
metric_definitions.cost: Reported process wall time on one shared GPU, not dedicated GPU-hours or from-scratch training time.

acceptance.no_new_acceptance_gate: Do not revoke the accepted LAFAN result because full-library retention fluctuates; do not add40/40, extra seeds, from-scratch speed or hardware parity as retrospective requirements.

scientific_conclusions.finding: Both P10 arms completed27000, adding18000 joint updates with the same parent, data, learner sizes and configured losses; only the hard reset quota differs.
scientific_conclusions.boundary: This is one fixed-parent/fixed-budget comparison. Both arms expanded to8192, so the independent causal effect of8192 versus4096 is not identified.

scientific_conclusions.finding: Hard practice improves local skill coverage and common-success hard quality: endpoint hard298 versus193; side_roll21/22 versus8/22; cartwheel85/120 versus10/120.
scientific_conclusions.boundary: It also loses168 other-BONES completions versus control and lowers other-BONES and LAFAN returns; do not declare a universally superior policy or dismiss the hard gains.

scientific_conclusions.finding: Both arms recover much of P9 full-library quality. On the128938 parent-and-both-complete clips, R rises from.84963943 to.87129883/control and.86426307/hard.
scientific_conclusions.boundary: Do not carry forward the P9 claim of continuing widespread quality deterioration. Root SO3 and all-body orientation reward are different quantities.

scientific_conclusions.finding: The hard arm visits all639 clips and all4286 reset bins; flip and handstand each receive millions of effective learner samples but remain0/44 and0/160.
scientific_conclusions.boundary: Generic missing-clip exposure is insufficient to explain these failures; per-bin effective continuous-window coverage and current same-input model errors remain distinct unknowns.

scientific_conclusions.finding: At the hard endpoint,150/160 handstands fail within1second;44flips fail at a median2.50seconds. Root-height failures dominate these two groups.
scientific_conclusions.boundary: Height termination identifies the observed failure condition, not a proven PD, actuator, contact, model or Actor cause.

scientific_conclusions.finding: The actual14501 Critic raw MSE reaches3.0226247903e23 while its actual weighted optimization objective is.2784879953; approximately99.9999976percent of squared error lies at exact-zero survival.
scientific_conclusions.boundary: This supports continued exclusion of dead suffix errors from Critic optimization, not a claim that the raw spike caused poor control or that lower weighted loss proves better policy.

scientific_conclusions.finding: Saved P10 selected imagined samples show height/vertical-velocity inconsistency even before survival becomes zero; older matched P9 same-action windows give complementary evidence.
scientific_conclusions.boundary: Selected imagined samples are biased diagnostics, not matched real prediction errors of the27000 model; parent9000 windows cannot be described as current27000 model evidence.

scientific_conclusions.finding: P11 can isolate a vertical-height update constraint while keeping the hard27000 parent and established hard practice.
scientific_conclusions.boundary: A trapezoidal endpoint relation is a modeling approximation, not exact MuJoCo substep integration or a proven bug fix. Its residual is forced near zero by construction and cannot be the success criterion.

An enforced zero consistency residual alone is not success.
